about_the_game:
Art Book KIBORG is a unique collection of materials that reveal the creative process behind our game. Inside, you’ll find two parts:

  • Concept Art & Illustrations – a curated selection of artwork, screenshots, and early sketches showcasing the evolution of the game’s visual style. Discover characters, environments, UI designs, and other elements that shaped our world.

  • Prequel Comic – an engaging backstory presented as a graphic novel. Dive into the events that preceded the main storyline and learn more about key characters and the game’s universe.

This art book is a must-have for fans and art enthusiasts, offering a behind-the-scenes look at the game’s development and deepening your connection to its world.
